causal_edges.explanation: Corrupted data flows from step 3 to step 4 because agent 2 reviewed an outdated version, causing agent 1 to apply irrelevant changes.
Agent 1 submits the updated but incorrect code (v1.2) for testing.
Tester detects issues due to the inconsistencies in the code version submitted.

root_cause_explanation: Agent 2 reviews an outdated version (v1.0) instead of the latest (v1.1), leading to state inconsistency.
